summary: Smoke test of Studio Vita backend + frontend. Backend seed data + auth + booking + contact endpoints all return 200. Frontend loads homepage with hero + all 4 journey cards, team page (6 cards), workshops (4 join buttons), FAQ, admin login + full admin dashboard with 5 tabs all working. Booking created via API is visible in admin bookings tab.
passed: Admin login flow: fill email/password → redirect to /admin succeeded
team-add button visible on Csapat tab, admin-logout visible
End-to-end integration: API-created booking appears in admin bookings UI
action_items: MINOR: Login response uses key 'token' (not 'access_token' as noted in problem statement). Frontend AuthContext must be reading 'token' — confirmed working since login succeeded and /api/auth/me returned 200. No fix needed unless spec strictly requires 'access_token' key.
notes: 10 console 401 errors observed but expected — they occur when /api/auth/me is called before login on public pages. Email delivery (Resend) not verified end-to-end but booking POST succeeded which is non-fatal for send failures per spec.
